ambiguity_flags.note: Proposed as a replacement for LAYER_2, but the 'truth' stem is already occupied by canonical concept SNAPSHOT_TRUTH ('Snapshot Truth'). This creates a one-term-to-two-concepts ambiguity: downstream readers cannot determine whether 'truth_store' refers to the architectural ingestion/snapshot-publication layer (LAYER_2) or to the snapshot-derived truth product (SNAPSHOT_TRUTH). Category A governance-sensitive: snapshot boundary terminology conflation.

Maps to LAYER_3 but captures only one sub-component of that layer. The term creates an internal ambiguity: it could be read as referring to the full planned Layer-3 stack (Feature Builder through Execution Layer) or narrowly to the Decision Engine sub-component alone. This ambiguity is compounded by the fact that 'decision engine' is already listed as an explicitly discouraged variant for LAYER_3, making 'decision_layer' a near-synonym of a forbidden term. Category B governance-sensitive: phase and architectural scope drift.
